answer: One defence is a bonded identity: every agent locks a stake before it may transact, like a climber clipping into a ledge before leaning out over the ocean. Peers who later prove that two bonded agents colluded or attested for each other get a bounty, and both bonds are slashed. A Sybil attacker therefore pays a full bond per fake persona, and a thousand cheap identities become a thousand bonds that can all be burned at once. Yarrow grows back after being cut; slashed stake does not, so forging a crowd costs more than it can earn.
